name: create_secret

dotenvFile.description: Absolute path to a UTF-8 .env file whose complete environment bundle should be stored. The file is read host-side after review; its values are never returned. Must not contain null bytes or line break characters.

availableToAgents.description: Whether agents may attach this reference to commands. Defaults to available.

description: Create one global secret from exactly one value source: inline environment arguments or an absolute host .env file. Returns safe metadata only and does not attach the secret to any agent.
